name: agent-plan-review
description: A React component for reviewing an AI agent's plan step by step — confirm each step, adjust its fields, or ask the agent to change it.
author: Esther Park

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css
scripts.deploy:demo: vite build && touch demo-dist/.nojekyll && cd demo-dist && rm -rf .git && git init -q -b gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -qm "Deploy demo" && git push -fq https://github.com/estherchaep/agent-plan-review.git gh-pages && rm -rf .git
